name: Jhajha–Devipur National Highway
significance: NH 333C is a branch of NH 333. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Jhajha to Devipur, and it meets NH 333 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 333 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Rāmpur to Railway Colony
